Bill.BriefDescription: Apportioning the votes of presidential electors proportionate to the popular vote.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to presidential electors; and adding a new sectionto chapter 29A.56 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 29A.56 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The legislature finds: (a) The right to vote for president of the United States is afundamental right and each person's vote is entitled to equal dignityand should count equally; and (b) The will of the Washington electorate would be best reflectedby the popular proportional allocation of electoral collegerepresentatives, based on the number of ballots cast for the respectivepresidential tickets in Washington. (2) The total number of electoral votes to which Washington isentitled shall be divided among the presidential tickets on the generalelection ballot, based upon the popular proportional share of the totalstatewide ballots cast for each presidential ticket, subject tosubsections (3) and (4) of this section. Each presidential electorshall vote for the presidential candidate and, by separate ballot, p. 1 SB 5596vicepresidential candidate on the presidential ticket of the politicalparty or political organization that nominated that presidentialelector. (3) The allocation of a presidential ticket's popular proportion ofthis state's electoral votes shall be in whole numbers and shall bemade in the following manner: (a) The total number of ballots cast in this state for eachpresidential ticket at a general election shall be divided by the totalnumber of ballots cast for all presidential tickets that receive votesat that general election; and (b) The proportion of a presidential ticket's popular vote, asdetermined in (a) of this subsection, shall be multiplied by the numberof electoral votes to which Washington is entitled. (4) The number of electoral votes that is attributable to theballots cast for any presidential ticket, as determined in subsection(3) of this section, shall be rounded to the nearest whole number,subject to the following limitations: (a) No presidential ticket may receive any electoral votes fromWashington if its proportion of the total ballots cast for allpresidential tickets would reflect less than a full electoral voteafter rounding to the nearest whole number; (b) If the sum of electoral votes allocated under (a) of thissubsection is greater than the number of electoral votes to whichWashington is entitled: (i) The allocation of electoral votes to the presidential ticketreceiving at least one electoral vote and the fewest number of ballotscast shall be reduced by whole electoral votes until only that numberof electoral votes to which Washington is entitled have been allocated;and (ii) The process in (b)(i) of this subsection shall be repeated if,after the reduction of electoral votes in (b)(i) of this subsection,the total number of electoral votes allocated to all presidentialtickets remains greater than the total number of electoral votes towhich Washington is entitled, and this process shall be applied to thepresidential ticket receiving at least one electoral vote and the nextfewest number of ballots cast until the total number of electoral votesallocated to all presidential tickets is equal to the number ofelectoral votes to which Washington is entitled; SB 5596 p. 2 (c) If the sum of all electoral votes allocated would be less thanthe number of electoral votes to which Washington is entitled, thepresidential ticket receiving the greatest number of ballots cast shallreceive any unallocated electoral votes until all of the electoralvotes to which Washington is entitled have been allocated. (5) The secretary of state shall adopt rules to apportion the votesof the presidential electors under this section.
